newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU, Mexico sign cognac and tequila deal.
newsitem.headline: EU, Mexico sign cognac and tequila deal.

text.p: The European Union and Mexico Tuesday signed a mutual-recognition accord for their leading liquors which is expected to boost bilateral trade in alcohol.
The deal means Mexico cannot market home grown versions of Scotch whisky and French champagne under the names of their European rivals.
Similarly, European manufacturers are forbidden from producing the traditional Mexican spirits tequila and mezcal, which currently account for 83 percent of Mexico's liquor exports.
